subtitle: 식당에서 계산하고 나누기
desc: 식사 후 계산서를 부탁하고 카드·팁을 말하는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Excuse me. Could we have the check, please?

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Sure. Would you like that together or split?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Together, please. Can I pay by card?

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Yes. We take Visa, Mastercard, and Apple Pay.

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: An eighteen percent service charge is already included.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Great. Could I get a receipt?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Printed is fine. Thank you. The food was excellent.
turns.ko: 인쇄로 주세요. 감사합니다. 음식이 정말 맛있었어요.

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: I'm glad you enjoyed it. Have a good evening.
turns.ko: 맛있게 드셨다니 기쁘네요. 좋은 저녁 되세요.

tips.en: Could we have the check, please?
